label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Web Analytics
body: Web analytics is the process of collecting, measuring, analyzing, and reporting web data to understand and optimize website usage.
caption:
For your online store or creator portfolio, web analytics helps you see what's working on your site. You can discover which pages people spend the most time on, where they come from, and if they're finding what they need. This insight can help you make smart choices to improve your website experience for visitors. Start by looking at your site's data today!
